hero_subtitle: Kang Chiao Students Photography Cooperative Organization
sec1_desc: Explore and establish campus imaging standards. By organizing pre-production parameters and post-production archiving standards, we aim to provide a stable technical reference and workflow guarantee for every high-quality visual recording.
sec2_desc: Through professional technical service capabilities, we establish collaborative mechanisms with multiple student organizations on campus, providing a comprehensive visual support network for complex campus events.
sec3_desc: Since its founding in 2022, KSVG has been fully student-operated, building a comprehensive organizational framework, imaging standards, and technical documentation. We remain committed to open-sourcing our core assets, offering governance models and technical infrastructure for reference by student organizations both on and off campus.
sec4_title: What is the KSVG™ Talent Pool Program?
sec4_desc: The KSVG™ Talent Pool Program provides a hands-on platform for students passionate about community development, covering daily operations, technical support, team collaboration, and logistics management.
